items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: His name was Garfield, one of the names Shack, one of the names Shag. So that's a musical family.

ctx.x: Cotter, C-R-T-E-R, Cotter. His name was Garfield, one of the names Shack, one of the names Shag. So that's a musical family. You know, Norfolk, in the beginning, used to be quite a little town. We called it Little New York. I mean, people danced there, there was dance bands, had the old booths there, the booths there, go up to Chesapeake, I guess, on picnics. Norfolk was a Little New Orleans or a Little New York.
That's where Jenkins' home was too, wasn't it, in Norfolk?
